title: Bishambhar Falls as Sikh Reinforcements Arrive

blocks.text: The battle first appears to go against the Singhs, whose smaller force is pressed by cavalry and driven back under the weight of the assault. That early advantage collapses when thousands of Singhs arrived after hearing the exchange of fire, turning what looked like a local setback into a massed Sikh counterattack.

Bishambhar realizes too late that the field is slipping from him. He dismounts and stands his ground, but the Singhs close around him, kill him in the fighting, and break the coherence of his army at the moment its confidence should have mattered most.

What follows is not a restrained victory but a sweeping seizure of camp wealth, animals, arms, and supplies. The page marks the military defeat of Bishambhar and the immediate conversion of that triumph into material advantage for the Khalsa.
